# Engineered features

Drug-class sensitivity screen, methylation strata, expression strata, cross-drug concordance, and composite vulnerability score (hypothesis-generating).

```{r load-ws-03, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}
if (file.exists(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS)) {
  ws <- readRDS(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS)
  for (nm in names(ws)) assign(nm, ws[[nm]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

```{r rcan1-expression, cache = FALSE}
if (exists("tpm") && exists("expr_target")) {
  rcan1_tpm <- tpm %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("^RCAN1\\b", .data$gene_name)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(.data$depmap_id, RCAN1 = .data$rna_expression)
  expr_target <- expr_target %>%
    dplyr::left_join(rcan1_tpm, by = "depmap_id")
}
```

```{r engineered-features-table, cache = FALSE}
stemai_features <- tibble::tibble()
if (exists("expr_target") && nrow(expr_target) > 0) {
  stemai_features <- expr_target %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::any_of(c(
        "depmap_id", "cell_line_name", "lineage_group", "stem_like_group", "stem_like_subtype",
        "BCL2", "MCL1", "BCL2L1", "RCAN1", "validation_partition"
      ))
    )
  if (exists("pair_df") && nrow(pair_df) > 0) {
    stemai_features <- stemai_features %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        pair_df %>% dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, dplyr::any_of(c("aza_sens", "ven_sens", "HMA_sens", "BCL2i_sens"))),
        by = "depmap_id"
      )
  }
  if (exists("merged_aza") && nrow(merged_aza) > 0 && "LNIC50" %in% names(merged_aza)) {
    stemai_features <- stemai_features %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        merged_aza %>% dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, LNIC50_DNMTi = .data$LNIC50),
        by = "depmap_id"
      )
  }
  if (exists("merged_bcl2i_gdsc") && nrow(merged_bcl2i_gdsc) > 0) {
    stemai_features <- stemai_features %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        merged_bcl2i_gdsc %>% dplyr::select(.data$depmap_id, LNIC50_BCL2i = .data$LNIC50),
        by = "depmap_id"
      )
  }
  stemai_features <- stemai_features %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      expr_stratum_BCL2 = dplyr::ntile(dplyr::coalesce(.data$BCL2, NA_real_), 4),
      dual_sensitive_flag = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(.data$LNIC50_DNMTi) & !is.na(.data$LNIC50_BCL2i) &
          .data$LNIC50_DNMTi <= stats::quantile(.data$LNIC50_DNMTi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) &
          .data$LNIC50_BCL2i <= stats::quantile(.data$LNIC50_BCL2i, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        1L, 0L, missing = 0L
      ),
      composite_vulnerability = dplyr::coalesce(.data$BCL2, 0) -
        dplyr::coalesce(.data$LNIC50_BCL2i, stats::median(.data$LNIC50_BCL2i, na.rm = TRUE)) -
        dplyr::coalesce(.data$LNIC50_DNMTi, stats::median(.data$LNIC50_DNMTi, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  saveRDS(stemai_features, STEMAI_FEATURES_RDS)
  readr::write_csv(stemai_features, file.path(stemai_data_dir, "StemAI_engineered_features.csv"))
}
```

```{r feature-summary-by-stem-like, cache = FALSE}
if (exists("stemai_features") && nrow(stemai_features) > 0) {
  summ <- stemai_features %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$stem_like_group == "Stem-like") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$stem_like_subtype) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      N = dplyr::n(),
      BCL2_median = round(median(.data$BCL2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      RCAN1_median = round(median(.data$RCAN1, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      dual_sensitive_n = sum(.data$dual_sensitive_flag == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$N))
  knitr::kable(summ, caption = "Engineered features by stem-like subtype (Panel 2–3 summary).")
}
```
